title: Why Recruiters Skip Your LinkedIn Profile in 10 Seconds
description:
Recruiters are not messaging you on LinkedIn and it is one specific thing on your profile causing it. In this video I break down the exact 3-part headline formula, the 4 header mistakes that kill your visibility, the About section framework that makes recruiters stop scrolling, and the Open to Work setting almost everybody gets wrong.

LinkedIn is not really a social network. It is a search engine for talent. 63% of LinkedIn's entire revenue comes from talent sourcing, and recruiters pay £9,500 per year per seat to find candidates like you. But the average candidate gets zero inbound messages — because their profile is not built for the way LinkedIn Recruiter actually searches.

In this video I'll walk you through the exact LinkedIn profile fix I used to take Adam from 200 applications and zero recruiter messages to over 50 inbound messages in 6 weeks.


What you'll learn:
- Why LinkedIn is a search engine, not a social network (and what that means for your profile)
- The 3-part headline formula that gets you into recruiter search results
- The 4 header mistakes 81% of candidates make in the part of the profile recruiters actually look at
- The 5-part About section story that makes recruiters stop and scroll
- The Open to Work setting almost everyone gets wrong
- The exact LinkedIn profile build my clients use to go from invisible to inbound
